event_name: Renault Sport Formula One Team Document 28 Date 10 June 2018 Time 14:57 2018 CANADIAN GRAND PRIX 7 - 10 June 2018 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Car 55 collided with Car 11 in turn 1.
offence: Involved in an alleged incident as defined by Art 38.1 as defined by the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video evidence that showed the cars were side by side coming into turn 1, there was enough room for both cars to avoid the collision, no driver was predominantely to blame for the incident. Gerd Ennser Jose Abed Emanuele Pirro Paul Cooke
title: 2018 Canadian Grand Prix Decision Car 55 Turn 1 Incident With Car 1128 0
